title: Real Agent Usage Metrics from Relay

summary.goal: Replace synthetic/random token counts in handleTaskCompletion() with real usage metrics from spawned agents. Currently the orchestrator generates fake values (Math.random() * 5000 for tokens, hardcoded 'sonnet' for model). Real metrics are needed for Tuner learning to be meaningful — Thompson sampling with fake data produces garbage model selection.

acceptance_criteria.description: tokens_used in TaskOutcomeEmission reflects actual tokens consumed by the agent (not random)
cost_usd in TaskOutcomeEmission reflects actual cost (derived from model pricing)
model_used in TaskOutcomeEmission reflects the actual model the agent used (not hardcoded 'sonnet')
duration_ms is measured from spawn to report_complete (already works, but verify accuracy)
Metrics are available even if the agent crashes (partial metrics from last known state)
Metrics source is documented: whether from relay process tracking, agent self-report via MCP, or CLI output parsing

observations: Orchestrator handleTaskCompletion() at line ~346 uses: Math.floor(Math.random() * 5000) + 1000 for tokens
model_used hardcoded to 'sonnet' with TODO comment
Relay client tracks spawned agents in spawnedAgents Map (pid, spawnedAt) but no usage data
Three potential metric sources: (a) relay daemon process stats, (b) agent self-reports via report_progress MCP, (c) CLI stdout parsing
Claude CLI outputs usage stats on exit — could be captured by relay daemon
The report_complete MCP tool currently doesn't accept usage metrics — could be extended
questions: Does the relay daemon capture process stdout/stderr that could contain usage data?
Should agents self-report metrics via an extended report_complete, or should relay capture them?
How do other CLIs (codex, gemini) report usage? Is there a common format?

architect.metric_consumers: Tuner (Thompson sampling, EMA baselines, drift detection)

approach_options.option_a: Extend report_complete MCP tool to accept tokens_used, cost_usd, model_used — agent self-reports
approach_options.option_b: Relay daemon captures CLI stdout on process exit, parses usage lines, stores in spawn metadata
approach_options.option_c: Hybrid: agent reports what it can, relay fills gaps from process-level data

architect.recommended: option_a for MVP (simplest, agent knows its own usage), option_c for production
